description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer cursor-presentation checkpoint: safe Rust composes existing DECTCEM visibility ownership with DEC private mode 12 cursor-blink state and reproduces Microsoft's independent and combined mode transitions.

entries.notes: Safe Rust starts with blinking and visibility enabled, applies DEC private mode 12 without disturbing visibility, applies DECTCEM mode 25 without disturbing blinking, and handles Microsoft's final combined ?12;25 reset as two parser-normalized SetMode actions.
